categories_thin: Optometry: one provider-directory lead only (Robert J. Silverman, OD, 365 Spotswood-Englishtown Rd). No optometrist with an independently confirmable Spotswood storefront was found.
Veterinary: no veterinary practice inside the borough. Searches return Monroe Animal Hospital, Monroe Parke Veterinary Hospital (Monroe Township) and Sayrebrook (Sayreville), all outside Spotswood.

Wealth management / independent financial advisers: the only Spotswood-address adviser found is an Ameriprise-branded team at 296 Summerhill Rd, which falls under the branded-franchise exclusion; other hits were bank brokerage offices (Wells Fargo Advisors, Chase, TD, Merrill).
Engineering / architecture / surveying: only an unopenable BuildZoom listing for an architect at a Devoe Ave address and firms in Monroe/Jamesburg; nothing confirmable in Spotswood.
Tutoring and test prep: only franchise learning centres in East Brunswick (Huntington, Genie Academy, Mathnasium/Kumon in Spotswood) surfaced, all excluded.
Child care: Childtime and The Goddard School are chains and excluded, leaving Pixie Pre-School plus child-care use at other addresses.

Printing and signs: after a re-search this is no longer empty - Tameless Designs (84 Adirondack Ave, screen printing/embroidery, reviews from 2026) is now listed; the only other printing option in town is The UPS Store (franchise, excluded).
Manufacturing / warehousing: the two plants previously listed (International Paper, Greif) were corporate sites and have been removed, leaving no eligible independent manufacturer in the borough.
caveats: Spotswood is a small borough (~8,000 residents); about 100 eligible independent businesses is a plausible ceiling, so this list is likely close to complete for businesses that advertise.

Inclusion rule applied consistently (replaces the earlier ad-hoc treatment of Cowleys): single-location independents are included, and central-NJ professional or trade firms that run more than one office are retained when the office itself is in Spotswood and the firm is not a franchise, branded chain or a site of a company with over 500 staff. Cowleys Pest Services (multi-office NJ pest firm that describes itself as locally owned) and Integrated Dermatology of NJ (multi-site dermatology practice) are both kept on that basis.

Removed in this revision: International Paper Spotswood Container Plant and Greif Bros (corporate plants of publicly traded manufacturers), Law Office of Pragati J. Parikh (own website gives a Millstone NJ office, so it is out of zone), Spotswood Dental Center (only an insurer PDF, no live listing at 438 Main St), Cookie Crumble & Things (status unconfirmed and only an unverifiable directory), and S & J Mechanical (no Spotswood address; one listing places it in Monroe Township and its reviews date from 2010-11).
Several trades firms publish only a residence-style street address; addresses are recorded exactly as the directories print them and may be home offices.

Service-area businesses rank for Spotswood searches without being located there; only firms with a Spotswood address or an explicit Spotswood base were included, except where noted (Silverman, Archer Mechanical, Executive Roofing).

WhereOrg, BBB, Vitals, D&B, BuildZoom, Yellow Pages, YellowBot and go-new-jersey all return HTTP 403 to direct fetching; entries resting on those sites are marked as single-source and need a phone or on-site check. MerchantCircle index snippets were used only where the individual profile would not render (Home Source Realty).

Excluded as chains/franchises or out of scope: The UPS Store (426 Main St), Wells Fargo Bank and Wells Fargo Advisors (200 Summerhill Rd), Goddard School (206 Summerhill Rd), Childtime (410 Main St), Snap Fitness (404 Main St), Mathnasium (508 Main St), Kumon (420 Main St), Spotswood Pharmacy (14 Snowhill St), Allstate agent Trinity Agency (407 Main St), Ameriprise team at 296 Summerhill Rd, GYMGUYZ Greater Middlesex, The Shop at St. Peter's, and Raritan Valley YMCA child care.

Archer Mechanical (7 Princeton Ave) and Executive Roofing Systems (1 American Way) were added on the checker's recommendation, but both rest on listings that block fetching (Nextdoor, D&B) or on a trade-association page that omits the town; their addresses/phones need a call.
Home Source Realty LLC: the individual MerchantCircle profile page would not render, so the 353 Main St address and (732) 251-6700 phone come from the MerchantCircle Spotswood index entry only.
Suite numbers conflict in two places: Kids' Corner Pediatrics (Suite A per Birdeye, Suite 2A per a Vitadox listing) and Archer Mechanical (7 vs 7B Princeton Ave).

Phone numbers could not be read for many salon, dental and contractor entries because the directories render them behind JavaScript or blank fields (e.g. Main Street Tire's contact page shows an empty phone field).

No Spotswood chamber of commerce or downtown business association member directory is published; the Middlesex County Regional Chamber directory lists only a couple of Spotswood members (one of them a franchise, excluded).
No borough business-licence or registry list is published online, so home-based businesses that do not advertise cannot be captured.

Spotswood Dental Center (438 Main St) and Beeline Plumbing appear only in single stale-looking listings and may no longer operate; 'Spotswood Appliance Repair' at 27 Snowhill St looked like a lead-generation listing and was excluded.
